retained_function: Some accepted work can finish while excess demand is explicitly refused
required_conditions: One effective intake authority and service capacity not consumed by an uncounted path
architectural_consequence: Account for accepted and rejected demand without pretending all offered work is served
counterexample: A plugin bypasses admission or exhausts all physical capacity

retained_function: Existing backlog can shrink before normal admission resumes
required_conditions: Both fresh intake and feedback retries can be restricted below actual degraded service
architectural_consequence: Specify an inspectable draining transition instead of only normal versus stopped
counterexample: An unknown external effect is retried or a live lease is released to make draining appear successful

retained_function: Work amplification remains accountable across kernel plugin SDK and participant calls
required_conditions: All retry producers are observable or bounded by an enforceable boundary
architectural_consequence: Persist business-operation identity separately from the permitted attempt budget
counterexample: An opaque SDK retries outside the budget or another task repeats the same business operation

candidate_structure: A bounded startup compartment with cooling opportunity
retained_function: A viable integration can bootstrap without its own restarts exhausting shared resources
required_conditions: Failure is transient or resource-related and startup limits really include descendants
architectural_consequence: Separate startup budget from steady-state budget and test cold entry from outside the running basin
counterexample: The binary is permanently broken so cooling only produces another failure

candidate_structure: Quarantined integration plus inspectable last evidence
retained_function: The damaged integration stops consuming restart attempts while its failure remains diagnosable
required_conditions: Diagnostics are captured safely and the diagnostic path does not require that integration
architectural_consequence: End retries after a bounded policy and require evidence before another activation
counterexample: Quarantine silently restarts elsewhere or destroys the only diagnostic evidence

retained_function: An unresolved incident remains visible to a later legitimate recipient
required_conditions: Record is durable accessible and not confused with acknowledgment or repair
architectural_consequence: Treat nobody available as a real holding regime rather than escalating into automatic consent
counterexample: All records or legitimate access paths are lost

retained_function: Repeated symptoms do not consume one human decision each
required_conditions: Grouping preserves distinct actionable incidents and at least one legitimate recipient is reachable
architectural_consequence: Budget human alarm load and test which distinctions grouping may erase
counterexample: Two genuinely different urgent incidents are mistakenly merged

candidate_structure: Inspectably bounded suppression and re-entry policy
retained_function: Temporary silence has an owner an end and a way back into actionable observation
required_conditions: Expiry is enforced independently enough and recurrence is addressed before repeated re-entry
architectural_consequence: Do not call an expiring mute a fix when it merely creates a flood-mute cycle
counterexample: The suppression clock fails or the unchanged flood overwhelms every reopening

candidate_structure: Rejected draft with its contradiction evidence
retained_function: Useful partial work and the reason not to release it remain available
required_conditions: The contradiction is legitimate and retaining the content is allowed
architectural_consequence: Keep worker output rejection evidence and permission to use separate
counterexample: The rejecting oracle is wrong or the artifact must legally be deleted

candidate_structure: Verifiable work package with explicit oracle provenance
retained_function: A later reviewer can inspect what criterion and evidence justified acceptance
required_conditions: A genuinely adequate independent criterion exists outside the toy model
architectural_consequence: Do not promote modelled perfect repair into an implemented universal verifier
counterexample: All judges share the same false source or no valid criterion exists

retained_function: One accepted business history persists despite competing local attempts
required_conditions: The actual participant rejects the excluded authority at its acceptance boundary
architectural_consequence: Test real fencing rather than interpreting local identity or green monitoring as ownership
counterexample: Two participants do not share the same exclusion rule

retained_function: Intent attempts uncertainty and eventual receipt remain tied to the original business operation
required_conditions: Required facts are durable and not reconstructed from current guesses
architectural_consequence: Permit an explicitly unknown outcome without turning timeout into failure or replay into resend
counterexample: Needed evidence was never persisted or an old snapshot omitted the operation

retained_function: Repeated requests do not necessarily create repeated business effects
required_conditions: Participant retention covers the uncertainty window and business identity truly matches
architectural_consequence: Treat participant memory as a separate conditional capability from the local pending journal
counterexample: The participant forgets the key or equivalent tasks use different keys

retained_function: Historical intent remains inspectable without gaining fresh execution authority
required_conditions: Restore is recognized and independent current evidence can be sought
architectural_consequence: Use a read-and-reconcile boundary before any potentially already executed queued work
counterexample: A manually copied snapshot bypasses the gate or no independent evidence remains
